# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 includes GPU rendering corrections for transformed shapes, flush handling, and native clip recording. These fixes retain the Skia m157 engine and leave the managed API unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles** — Corrects axis mapping for transformed stroke widths and rounded-rectangle radii, including quarter-turn transforms. Corner radii are clamped to half the transformed bounds to prevent overlap. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Keep Ganesh atlas work aligned with flushes** — Fixes stale flush tracking after empty GPU flushes so atlas work from one flush is not treated as pending in a later flush. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Bound native Graphite clip recording** — The bundled engine counts pending clips without double-counting recorded clips and allows passes exactly at capacity. A draw whose full clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding capacity. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
